children: Reference is made to the proposed supplemental cash dividend to the shareholders of Goodtech ASA announced on 17 September 2026.
The Board of Directors will propose to the Extraordinary General Meeting a supplemental dividend of NOK 2.00 per share for the financial year 2025.
Subject to approval by the Extraordinary General Meeting, the dividend will be distributed according to the following key dates:
Shareholders registered in the VPS on the record date will be entitled to receive the dividend.
This announcement is made in accordance with Oslo Børs requirements for separate disclosure of cash dividend proposals and key dates.
